## Verification evidence

checks on documentation-only changes.

## Review and handoff

- [ ] Scope and decisions match the approved Issue; new choices are explicitly labeled.
- [ ] Relevant contracts and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Known issues and risks are recorded; no secrets or private data are included.
- [ ] Human review is recorded.
- [ ] Muse independent QA findings and disposition are recorded.
- [ ] Required fixes and regression checks are complete, or exceptions await Tech Lead decision.
- [ ] Tech Lead acceptance is recorded before merge.

Owner / human reviewer / QA owner:

Unresolved findings and handoff notes:

Workflow: Issue → short-lived branch → implementation → PR → human review → Muse
independent QA → fixes / regression → Tech Lead merge. Coding agents must not merge.
See [AGENTS](../AGENTS.md), [OPS](../OPS.md), and the
[module handoff guide](../docs/DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.zh-CN.md).
